yakkamon.heading: Get ready for
yakkamon.intro: Yakkamon is an idle farming automation and creature collection battle game. Catch, train, and gather resources on the Ronin blockchain. Discover how to maximize your time and resources in this new adventure.
yakkamon.intro.more: Developed by the same team behind Sunflower Land, Yakkamon combines strategic farm management with a deep monster collection and evolution system. Operating on the Ronin network, it ensures fast transactions and a vibrant ecosystem where players can compete on leaderboards, participate in exclusive airdrops, and forge tactical alliances.

yakkamon.faq.q1: Am I too late if I missed the Yakkamon Free Mint?
yakkamon.faq.a1: Not at all! Even though the Free Mint has closed, you are still very early. You can still register to claim your Monster Egg and start accumulating points to secure your spot in the Top 5,000 Airdrop. We'll keep you updated on all upcoming dates right here.
yakkamon.faq.q2: Will Yakkamon have a new token or use an existing one?
yakkamon.faq.a2: Based on the official information we've reviewed, there won't be a new token. Yakkamon will use $FLOWER, sharing Sunflower Land's ecosystem. We recommend depositing your $FLOWER to secure extra leaderboard points.
yakkamon.faq.q3: When will I be able to play Yakkamon?
yakkamon.faq.a3: Early Access is scheduled for November or December 2026. Keep in mind that access will open in waves, so staying high in the ranking we track above will be crucial to get in first.
yakkamon.faq.q4: Do I need to have played Sunflower Land to participate?
yakkamon.faq.a4: Not at all! It's a completely independent experience. At 0x Leñador, we encourage you to pre-register with just your email, even if you've never touched Sunflower Land. Everyone starts from scratch.
yakkamon.faq.q5: I've seen multiple events: Monster Egg, Airdrop, and Free Mint. What's the difference?
yakkamon.faq.a5: It can be confusing, but let me clear it up: the Monster Egg is given just for registering; the legendary monster Airdrop is exclusive to the Top 5,000 on the leaderboard; and the Free Mint was a closed event on the Ronin network in September. Follow our table above to catch what's next!
